findings.message: A time-bound result needs a study of that duration, with the qualifier shown on the creative.
findings.fix: Keep the timeframe only if it comes from a study you can cite, and put the qualifier in the footnote (e.g. '*Consumer perception study, 4 weeks'). Otherwise remove the timeframe.
findings.note: Wording appears on the product page (F7). Severity lowered one step: the brand has published it, but a reviewer must still confirm substantiation is on file.

findings.message: Authority claims need the specific study or endorsement on file, described accurately.
findings.fix: Use the exact, narrower wording you can support, e.g. 'Patch tested for safety under the supervision of a Dermatologist', or name the test ('In-vivo SPF test, ISO 24444:2019').
